lines.japanese: ホーメイは「それではまた」と言ってるわりにぽけっとして動かなかったが、俺が犬を払うような手振りで追いたててやると、最後に一瞥残してきびすを返した。
lines.english: For someone who had said goodbye, Phoenixsong stood there blankly and made no move to leave. I shooed her off with the sort of gesture one used on a dog, and at last she turned on her heel, leaving me one final glance.

lines.japanese: なんつーか、見えなくなるまで見送らないと、どうにもこっちが落ちつかない背中だった。
lines.english: There was something about that retreating back that would not let me settle until I had watched it disappear.

lines.japanese: と言ってるそばから。
lines.english: And no sooner had I thought it—

lines.japanese: 自動改札機までのほんの数歩の途中で、やつの服だか鞄だかから何かがこぼれた。
lines.english: In the handful of steps between us and the automatic gates, something fell from her clothes or her bag.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっ……おい」
lines.english: “Hey—wait.”

lines.japanese: 呼びかけながら前へ進んだ。合皮張りの表面に生徒手帳と彫ってある。
lines.english: I called after her as I went forward to retrieve it. The words STUDENT HANDBOOK were stamped into its imitation-leather cover.

lines.japanese: キャバ嬢っぽいねーさんがピンヒールで踏んづけていきそうになったそれを、俺は間一髪で拾いあげた。しかしホーメイの歩みは止まらない。
lines.english: A hostess-looking woman nearly drove a stiletto heel through it, but I snatched it up just in time. Phoenixsong kept walking.

lines.japanese: 「おい！　おい待てって！」
lines.english: “Hey! Hey, wait!”

lines.japanese: 定期券が投入口に吸いこまれた。やつは改札を越えてしまった。小さい体がすたすた遠ざかる。俺は改札機に手をかけ、身を乗りだして叫んだ。
lines.english: Her commuter pass vanished into the slot. She was through the gate now, her little body marching briskly away. I braced one hand on the gate, leaned across it, and shouted.
“Naru!”

lines.japanese: ぐりんっ──と、やつは振りかえった。横に広がった唇のあいだに、閉じた歯列が覗いている。やな笑顔。
lines.english: She whirled around. Her lips stretched wide, exposing a closed row of teeth. That rotten grin.

lines.japanese: 「……なんだよ。おい、落としもんだよ。拾得者に一割の報労金よこせコラ」
lines.english: “...What? Hey, you dropped something. Finder's fee is ten percent, so cough it up.”

lines.japanese: 俺は改札機横の柵の上から手を伸ばして、生徒手帳を差しむけた。落とし主が小走りで戻ってきて手に取る。やな笑顔。
lines.english: I reached over the railing beside the gate and offered her the handbook. Its owner came trotting back and took it from me. That rotten grin.

lines.japanese: 「んだよ。なに笑ってんだよ」
lines.english: “What? What are you smiling at?”

lines.japanese: 「やー、いきなり下の名前を呼び捨てとは畏れいりましたねー」
lines.english: “My, my. Straight to my given name, with no title or anything. I'm impressed.”

lines.japanese: 「っせーな、仕方ねーだろ。上の名前じゃ兄貴とごっちゃンなっちゃうじゃねーか」
lines.english: “Shut up. What else was I supposed to call you? Your family name would get confused with your brother's.”

lines.japanese: 「照れてる照れてる」
lines.english: “You're blushing. You're blushing.”

lines.japanese: ホーメイ……つーか鳴は、受けとった手帳の端っこを上から摘んで、目の横でひらひら揺らす。やな笑顔。
lines.english: Phoenixsong—or rather, Naru—pinched one corner of the handbook between two fingers and fluttered it beside her eye. That rotten grin.

lines.japanese: 「いやいやー、実は名前を呼ばせるためにわざと落としたんですねー。ナイス知能犯、私ー」
lines.english: “Actually, I dropped it on purpose to make you call me by name. What a brilliant criminal mastermind I am.”

lines.japanese: 「はァ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 俺は柵の手すりを掴んだ。力が抜けそうだった。
lines.english: I gripped the railing. I could feel all the strength leaving my body.

lines.japanese: 「なに。なにコレ。なに俺、殴っていいのコレ」
lines.english: “What. What is this? Am I allowed to hit you now?”

lines.japanese: 「はいっ、どうぞ！」
lines.english: “Yes! Please do!”

lines.japanese: 鳴はまた前髪を掻きわけると、両腕をぴったり脇につけ、気を付けの姿勢で俺の反撃に備えた。
lines.english: Naru swept her bangs aside again, pinned both arms neatly to her sides, and stood at attention to receive my counterattack.

lines.japanese: 「……あのなあ」
lines.english: “...Listen, you.”

lines.japanese: 俺は聞こえるように溜息をこぼし、右のこぶしと左の掌底を音高く打ちあわせた。
lines.english: I sighed loudly enough for her to hear, then cracked my right fist into my left palm.

lines.japanese: 「ひいいー！」
lines.english: “Eeeeeek!”

lines.japanese: やつがきつく目を閉じる。腕を垂らしたままで両肩がすぼまった。俺は呆れる。なんでこいつ、こんな楽しそうなんだ？
lines.english: She squeezed her eyes shut. Her arms stayed at her sides while her shoulders hunched up around her ears. I stared at her in disbelief. Why the hell was she having so much fun?

lines.japanese: 思わずいたずら心が湧いた。
lines.english: A mischievous impulse came over me.

lines.japanese: 俺は舌先で頬の裏側を突付きながら、真横へさっと目を走らせた。有人改札口の係員は、年老いたご婦人を接客中でこちらを見ていなかった。
lines.english: Prodding the inside of my cheek with the tip of my tongue, I flicked a glance sideways. The attendant at the staffed gate was helping an elderly lady and had his eyes elsewhere.

lines.japanese: 俺は柵越しに右腕を伸ばし、鳴の小さい頭に手を回した。わりと強引に。
lines.english: I reached my right arm across the railing and hooked one hand around Naru's little head. With a fair degree of force.

lines.japanese: 瞬間、やつは驚いて目を開けたみたいだった。しかし構わず引きよせる。
lines.english: Her eyes flew open in surprise. I pulled her toward me anyway.

lines.japanese: ニキビのあとが残った隙だらけの額に、俺は冬の風で荒れた唇を素早く押しつけた。
lines.english: I quickly pressed my winter-chapped lips to her unguarded forehead, where the faint mark of a fading pimple remained.

lines.japanese: 一瞬の不意打ちに、小娘は言葉を失って身を引いた。
lines.english: The ambush struck the girl speechless. She recoiled.

lines.japanese: 「口閉じろ口」
lines.english: “Close your mouth.”

lines.japanese: 俺は少し柵から離れた。鳴は一回こくりと頷いたが、口は開いたままだった。
lines.english: I stepped back from the railing. Naru gave one tiny nod, but her mouth remained open.

lines.japanese: あたり一帯に、ちょっとだけ苛立ったみたいな駅員のアナウンスが響きわたった。下り方面、本日の最終電車まもなく発車いたします、ご利用のお客様はお急ぎください──券売機付近にいた連中が一斉に走りだす。
lines.english: An announcement rang across the station in a voice that sounded faintly irritated. The day's final outbound train would depart shortly; all passengers were requested to hurry. Everyone near the ticket machines broke into a run at once.

lines.japanese: 「行け。とりあえず行け」
lines.english: “Go. Just go, for now.”

lines.japanese: 俺は両手を作業着のポケットに押しこみ、顎先で鳴を促した。
lines.english: I shoved both hands into the pockets of my work clothes and jerked my chin at Naru.
“Y-yes...”

lines.japanese: やつは体の向きを変えないまま、一歩二歩三歩と後じさりはじめた。
lines.english: Without turning around, she began backing away. One step, two, three.
“Eep—”

lines.japanese: 足が絡んで五歩目で転んだ。色気もない薄ピンクだった。
lines.english: Her feet tangled on the fifth step, and down she went. Pale pink. Not remotely alluring.

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿。気ぃ付けろ」
lines.english: “Idiot. Watch where you're going.”

lines.japanese: 俺は頬の筋肉が緩むのを隠さなかった。
lines.english: I made no attempt to hide the smile tugging at my cheeks.

lines.japanese: 車掌がドアから半身を覗かせて、ホームに残った客を促しはじめた。立ちあがった鳴は、汚れた尻をぱたぱたはたきながら、俺に向かって慌ただしく一回腰を折りまげた。
lines.english: The conductor leaned halfway out of the doors and began waving the remaining passengers aboard. Back on her feet, Naru hurriedly patted the dirt from her backside, then bent once at the waist in my direction.

lines.japanese: さようなら？　ありがとうございました？
lines.english: Goodbye? Thank you?

lines.japanese: まあ、どっちでもいい。
lines.english: Either one would do.

lines.japanese: 「おう」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 俺はぎこちなく右腕を持ちあげ、やつにてのひらを見せる。
lines.english: I raised my right arm stiffly and showed her my palm.

lines.japanese: 鳴はにんまり笑っていた。形のいい八重歯がこぼれていた。それはかつて柳木原の皇帝陛下さえ優しさを差しむけたという笑顔。
lines.english: Naru grinned from ear to ear, one shapely little snaggletooth peeking out. The smile that had supposedly moved even His Imperial Majesty of Yanagihara to show kindness once upon a time.

lines.japanese: 俺はその無防備な無邪気を目にして、初めてあのイカれた兄貴に共感を覚えた気がした。
lines.english: Looking at that defenseless innocence, I felt, for the first time, that I understood her lunatic brother.

lines.japanese: そして、ホームから呑気な発車の音楽が鳴りわたる。
lines.english: Then the platform filled with a carefree departure melody.

lines.japanese: 鳴は無様に慌てふためきながら、今度こそ満員の最終電車に飛びこんでいった。
lines.english: Naru dissolved into spectacular panic and, this time, flung herself into the packed last train.

lines.japanese: 走りだしたアルミの箱を見送りながら、俺はまたひとつじいさんの言葉を思いだす。抑圧されていた笑顔は、解放されたとき何より美しく花開くとか何とか。
lines.english: As I watched the aluminum box pull away, another of the old man's sayings returned to me: when a long-suppressed smile is finally set free, it blooms more beautifully than anything. Something like that.

lines.japanese: 今更過ぎだけど、なんかちょっと分かった気がする。
lines.english: Much too late now, but I thought I understood it a little.

lines.japanese: まあ、だからなんだって話。
lines.english: Not that it meant anything.

lines.japanese: 世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: *May peace prevail on Earth*.
